name: Holocaust
overview: The Scriptures acknowledge times of unparalleled tribulation and suffering, describing a period of great distress unlike any before (Matthew 24:21). Believers are called to endure faithfully until the end to receive salvation (Matthew 24:13), relying on God’s strength and help in fearful times (Isaiah 41:10). Prayerful vigilance is urged so that Christians may be found worthy to escape these trials and stand before Christ (Luke 21:36). Despite opposition and persecution by forces that seek to wear out the saints (Daniel 7:25), God’s people are assured that He hears their cries and will uphold them (Psalms 83:1).
